#!/usr/bin/env node
// Generated by prepare-owned-field-bulk.mjs; explicit owned-field CLI contract.
// Complete project translation and all original storage bounds remain required.
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { regenerate } from "../tools/translation/owned-field-bulk.mjs";
import {regenerateCompilationMatrix} from "../tools/translation/owned-field-matrix-bulk.mjs";
import {createCompilationMatrix,DECLARED_FAMILY_PROFILES} from '../tools/translation/compilation-matrix.mjs';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
let root = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..'), check = false,profileMatrix=false,progress=false,retainOutputText=false,ownedCoreDefinitions=false;
const entries = [];
for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index++) {
  const argument = args[index];
  if (argument === '--check') check = true;
  else if(argument==='--profile-matrix')profileMatrix=true;
  else if(argument==='--progress')progress=true;
  else if(argument==='--retain-output-text')retainOutputText=true;
  else if(argument==='--owned-core-definitions')ownedCoreDefinitions=true;
  else if (['--root', '--entry'].includes(argument) && args[index + 1] && !args[index + 1].startsWith('--')) {
    const value = args[++index];
    if (argument === '--root') root = resolve(value); else entries.push(value);
  } else throw new Error('Usage: node scripts/translate-router.mjs [--check] [--progress] [--profile-matrix] [--retain-output-text] [--owned-core-definitions] [--root REPOSITORY] [--entry TRACKED_RS]');
}
if(!retainOutputText||ownedCoreDefinitions)throw new TypeError('Native owned-field CLI requires --retain-output-text and does not support --owned-core-definitions');
const progressStarted=process.hrtime.bigint();
const options={root,check,entries:entries.length?entries:undefined,progress:progress?record=>process.stderr.write(JSON.stringify({...record,elapsedMilliseconds:Number((process.hrtime.bigint()-progressStarted)/1_000_000n)})+'\n'):undefined};
// Complete matrix CLI: sequential source-derived process lifetime.
if(profileMatrix){
  const name=ownedCoreDefinitions?(retainOutputText?'isolated-retained-owned-definitions-matrix-bulk.mjs':'isolated-owned-definitions-matrix-bulk.mjs'):(retainOutputText?"isolated-native-retained-owned-field-matrix-bulk.mjs":"isolated-owned-field-matrix-bulk.mjs");
  const module=await import('../tools/translation/'+name);
  const {manifest,failures}=module.regenerateCompilationMatrix({...options,matrix:createCompilationMatrix({profiles:DECLARED_FAMILY_PROFILES})});
  console.log(JSON.stringify(ownedCoreDefinitions?{ownedCoreDefinitions:true,definitionOnly:true,projects:manifest.projects,runtimeParity:false,mode:check?'check':'write'}:{kind:manifest.schema,matrixSha256:manifest.matrixSha256,sourceSetSha256:manifest.sourceSetSha256,profiles:manifest.profiles.map(member=>({name:member.name,profileSha256:member.profileSha256,totals:member.totals,projects:member.projects})),platformDomainComplete:false,commonExecutableOutput:false,runtimeParity:false,mode:check?'check':'write'}));
  if(failures.length){console.error(failures.join('\n'));process.exitCode=1;}
}else if(ownedCoreDefinitions){
  const name=profileMatrix?(retainOutputText?'retained-owned-definitions-matrix-bulk.mjs':'owned-definitions-matrix-bulk.mjs'):(retainOutputText?'retained-owned-definitions-bulk.mjs':'owned-definitions-bulk.mjs');
  import('../tools/translation/'+name).then(module=>{
    const produce=profileMatrix?module.regenerateCompilationMatrix:module.regenerate;
    const {manifest,failures}=profileMatrix?produce({...options,matrix:createCompilationMatrix({profiles:DECLARED_FAMILY_PROFILES})}):produce(options);
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ownedCoreDefinitions:true,definitionOnly:true,projects:manifest.projects,runtimeParity:false,mode:check?'check':'write'}));
    if(failures.length){console.error(failures.join('\n'));process.exitCode=1;}
  }).catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;});
}else if(!retainOutputText){
const { manifest, failures } = profileMatrix?regenerateCompilationMatrix({...options,matrix:createCompilationMatrix({profiles:DECLARED_FAMILY_PROFILES})}):regenerate(options);
console.log(JSON.stringify(profileMatrix?{kind:manifest.schema,matrixSha256:manifest.matrixSha256,sourceSetSha256:manifest.sourceSetSha256,profiles:manifest.profiles.map(member=>({name:member.name,profileSha256:member.profileSha256,totals:member.totals,projects:member.projects})),platformDomainComplete:false,commonExecutableOutput:false,runtimeParity:false,mode:check?'check':'write'}:{ ...manifest.totals, projects: manifest.projects, runtimeParity: false, mode: check ? 'check' : 'write' }));
if (failures.length) {
  console.error(failures.join('\n'));
  process.exitCode = 1;
}
}else{
  // Explicit new stock-private-collection storage observer contract.
  const loading=profileMatrix?import("../tools/translation/native-retained-owned-field-matrix-bulk.mjs"):import("../tools/translation/native-retained-owned-field-bulk.mjs");
  loading.then(module=>{
    const produce=profileMatrix?module.regenerateCompilationMatrix:module.regenerate;
const { manifest, failures } = profileMatrix?produce({...options,matrix:createCompilationMatrix({profiles:DECLARED_FAMILY_PROFILES})}):produce(options);
console.log(JSON.stringify(profileMatrix?{kind:manifest.schema,matrixSha256:manifest.matrixSha256,sourceSetSha256:manifest.sourceSetSha256,profiles:manifest.profiles.map(member=>({name:member.name,profileSha256:member.profileSha256,totals:member.totals,projects:member.projects})),platformDomainComplete:false,commonExecutableOutput:false,runtimeParity:false,mode:check?'check':'write'}:{ ...manifest.totals, projects: manifest.projects, runtimeParity: false, mode: check ? 'check' : 'write' }));
if (failures.length) {
  console.error(failures.join('\n'));
  process.exitCode = 1;
}
  }).catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;});
}
